name: OPERATOR 2026-11-10 19:00: the score is now measured over HTTP, like the baselines
note: Until now the evaluator timed the engine inside its own process while every baseline on this board is tokens per second seen by a client over HTTP; on Qwen3-8B the same engines differ by about 0.12 ms per token between the two, which is 3-6% at 2-3.5 ms per token. From now on every sealed evaluation serves the submitted engine behind the harness's HTTP front end (eval/serve_engine.py: submit()/poll() when the engine has them, else reset()/step()) and measures it with the baselines' client (prompt 64, 1024 new tokens, batch 1 and 8, 1 warm-up + 3 repeats). Headline: http_step_us_b1 = 1e6 * B / decode tokens per second at B=1; perf.b8.http_step_us next to it. Speedups and milestones use only this figure; step_us, generate_step_us, MBU and the trace stay in the result as diagnostics. New gate http_tokens: the tokens the server streams for the check's prompts must be the engine's own step-by-step greedy tokens. Submissions evaluated before the change are evaluated again by the operator and appear as new rows; rows with the old metric are no longer ranked. The skill's section on the evaluator has been updated.
